Name: Actually Sad Shane - Portrait Mod
Author: stardewaly13
Description:
Ever thought Shane looked pissed off in his portrait when he says something sad? Or when he doesn't like your gift?

Well, no more!

[b]Thanks to the Actually Sad Shane Mod, now your favourite depressed chicken man will actually look sad when he should! [/b]

No more will he be like,

[i]"I never really had a family growing up -_-"
[/i]
Instead he'll be like
[i]
"I never really had a family growing up :("[/i]

WOW! What a difference!

[b]Wait, Stardew Aly, how did you manage to do this?[/b]

It's simple! Using the frame from when he's talking to Charlie, we (meaning me) was able to seamlessly move the face so it's still [b]technically vanilla designed!![/b]

[b]We have Sad Shane in both Normal AND Winter! WOW! AMAZING![/b]

But wait!
[b]
Are you a mod author and actually WANT the pissed off looking Shane?[/b]

YOU CAN STILL HAVE IT! If you use this mod, you will have to use the "$11" in your dialogue instead of "$2" or "$s" for the portrait, you can still have our precious angry Joja man! 

[b]Wait, I want my own Actually Sad Shane! How does this mod work to install it?[/b]

Well, that's easy! 

Just download this mod, put it into your mod folder like any other mod, and you can have your very own Actually Sad Shane!

[center][b][color=#980000]Warning: may not work with other mods that change his portrait. I am also unsure if Concerned Ape meant to have him look pissed in some pieces of dialogue and he may look sad when he's supposed to look pissed but then I feel like he'd use the mad portrait instead.[/color][/b][/center]

[center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42860/42860-1782247930-937568896.png[/img][/b][/center]
[b]
[i]In all seriousness, I made this mod for Stardew Mod Fest 2026! I'm still new to modding and I'm working on my Custom NPC mod of Rosalie (Who is out now!!!), and just in case I don't get it out in time, I thought I'd still submit something quick and easy :) 

[/i][/b](And yes, Shane will have a big role in Rosalie's mod, so keep an eye out please! <3)

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue with Shane's portrait being out of place.
